# Ip2Proxy

IP2Proxy is a proxy detection web service that identifies anonymous proxies, VPNs, TOR exit nodes, search engine robots, and residential proxies by IP address.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ip2proxy/.

## Actions

- **Check Proxy Status of an IP** (read-only): Check if an IP address is a proxy.
